# Art Archive

The public gallery is served at [danielarifriedman.com/art.html](https://danielarifriedman.com/art.html) from `data/artworks.json`, which stores Flickr-hosted image URLs and per-work metadata.

This directory keeps lightweight artwork metadata. The former full JPG mirror was removed from the deploy branch because it made the GitHub Pages artifact exceed the 1 GB deployment limit.

Primary sources:

- Gallery page: [../art.html](../art.html)
- Structured data: [../data/artworks.json](../data/artworks.json)
- Flickr archive: [Daniel Friedman on Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/43693624@N07/)
